data.name: Basileo
data.gender_notes: Basileo is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'basileus', meaning 'king', 'sovereign', or 'ruler'. In the Bible, Basileo is a title given to Jesus in the New Testament. The name Basileo carries the meaning “King, Ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Basileo usually hope their child will grow to embody king, ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes God's sovereignty and rule over our lives.
data.etymology: Basileo belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “King, Ruler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Basileo total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: באסילאו
in_hebrew.meaning: מלך פירוש השם באסילאו הוא מלך או שליט
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם באסילאו מגיע מהמילה היוונית βασιλεύς (basileus), שפירושה מלך או שליט. השם נמצא בשימוש במסורת הנוצרית ומשמש כזכר לשלטון ולכוח הרוחני של אלוהים. השם קשור למושג המלכות האלוהית והשלטון המשיחי.

in_greek.name: Βασιλέο
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Βασιλέο προέρχεται από το ελληνικό სიტύ βασιλεύς (basileus), που σημαίνει βασιλιάς ή κυβερνήτης. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, ο όρος χρησιμοποιείται για να περιγράψει τον Θεό ως τον υπέρτατο κυβερνήτη του σύμπαντος. Το όνομα έχει ιστορική σημασία στην πρώιμη Εκκλησία και συμβολίζει την πνευματική και θεϊκή εξουσία.

in_latin.name: Basileo
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Basileo originates from the Greek word βασιλεύς (basileus), meaning king or ruler. In Christian tradition, it signifies the divine authority and sovereignty of God. The name holds historical significance in the early Christian church, reflecting the eschatological hope for a messianic ruler.

in_english.name: Basileo
in_english.long_meaning: The name Basileo is derived from the Greek βασιλεύς (basileus), meaning king or ruler. In Christian tradition, Basileo symbolizes divine sovereignty and authority. Historically, the name reflects the early Christian hope for a messianic king. It connotes spiritual leadership and power, echoing biblical themes of God's kingdom and rule.

data.cultural_impact: The name Basileo is deeply rooted in Greek culture and history, which was the cradle of European civilization. This name reflects the power, strength, and authority associated with ancient Greek monarchs. In Christian culture, the name has an added significance as a name given to Jesus, emphasizing His royalty and sovereignty as the King of Kings.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Basileo highlights the kingship of Jesus, emphasizing His divine nature and His role as the Ruler of the universe. It speaks of His uncontested authority over all of creation, and ultimately, the salvation and redemption He offers as the reigning monarch of heaven and earth. The name Basileo is a powerful reminder of our identity as citizens of His eternal kingdom and encourages us to live in light of His kingship and rule in our lives.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Basileo in Greek means "king" or "ruler." In a spiritual sense, it symbolizes the divine kingship of God over our lives and the call for Christians to rule their passions and actions with love and wisdom, as God's representatives on earth.

biblical_reference.note: Though not directly mentioned in the Bible, the term βασιλεύς (basileus) is used to refer to God and Jesus Christ as King.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Basileios was a Byzantine emperor, ruling from 867 to 886. The name Basileo carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Basileo remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.
